assertions.name: family_a_fit_recovers_truncated_coefficients
assertions.source: Family A is symbolically 5/2 + (3/4)h², so the mpf fit must recover a_0 = 5/2, a_2 = 3/4, a_4 = a_6 = a_8 = 0 to 1e-25 precision (50 dps L1 floor)

description: Independent mp.mpf 50-dps verification of the Borromean Markov-trace h-expansion. Uses PR #1285's precision-fixed markov_trace_for_knot to compute tr_M(β_𝓑, q) at 5 sampled q values, then fits Σ_{j even} a_j · h^j via mpf-precision linear algebra. Compares against PR #1272's f64 'via_jones' coefficients and PR #1276's 'Bring + Faddeev h⁴' candidate. EXPLORATORY — does not change production linking_weight or any blocks.

parameters.h_expansion_method: 5×5 mp.mpf Vandermonde linear solve on q ∈ {1.05, 1.07, 1.09, 1.11, 1.13} at 50 dps

structural_finding.interpretation: wenzl tr_M has a_0=1, via_jones has a_0=2.5; they use different normalizations. The factor 2.5 is the Family A h⁰ leading coefficient. Even after scaling, the a_4, a_6 do not match — different h-expansion structure.
structural_finding.bring_faddeev_h_expansion_singular: PR #1276's 1/(1−h·q^10) + 1/(1−h⁴) − 1 expands as a rational with wildly growing h-coefficients (a_0=1.35, a_2=-54, a_4=5149, a_6=-147206). The candidate is NOT an h-series modification of Family A; it's a rational evaluation matching at q_0 specifically.
